name: chat
description: A conversation region: a named area holding a transcript and a composer. A person can keep several chats and move between them from the menu at the top, place the region in a pane or the middle, or pop it out into a window of its own. It is a component like any other, so it can be placed anywhere on a canvas, restyled, or removed.

use.when: the conversation belongs on the canvas beside the person's content; it is always at /chat as well.
use.with: a pane, when the person wants it beside what they are working on.

label.description: Names the region, so landmark navigation can reach it.

layout.title: Look
layout.description: panel gives it a surface and a visible title; bare drops the chrome so it sits inside another surface, with the title kept for screen readers.

slot.description: The transcript and composer. Server code passes rendered components; props from a model or a form are escaped as text.

keyboard.does: moves through the transcript's links and the composer

wcag.notes: A named region, so it is reachable by landmark navigation wherever it is placed (2.4.1). The title stays in the accessibility tree in bare layout, so removing the visual chrome never removes the name. The transcript is a list, so turn counts are announced.

machine.identify: A section whose accessible name is the label. The transcript is the list inside it and the composer is its form. The menu at the top names the current chat and lists the others.
machine.operate: Fill the textbox named by its label and activate the submit button. New chat starts another chat; each chat in the list opens with its own button, and Delete removes it. Place moves the region to a pane or the middle and sets its width. If this region has been removed from the canvas, the same conversation is always at /chat and POST /api/chat.
